overall_notes: The paper focuses on improving mathematical reasoning capabilities through self-critique mechanisms using reinforcement learning. The main NLG task is mathematical reasoning with generated reasoning processes, critiques, and corrections. Evaluation uses only automatic metrics (Accuracy, BoN@N, Maj@N) focused on correctness of mathematical answers. The LLM annotation is for training data synthesis, not post-generation evaluation.
